why.violence: No people or animals are ever shown. A missed landing dents the car and throws debris: vehicle damage only, no injury, no blood.
why.contests: The board ranks landings; there are no prizes, entry fees or sweepstakes.
why.userGeneratedContent: Yes, truthfully (18-0's lesson): three letters A to Z as initials, shown on the public board. No other text, profile, chat or messaging. Apple may ask how it is moderated (guideline 1.2): see store/review-reply.md.
why.unrestrictedWebAccess: No in-app browser. A challenge link opens the web game in Safari.
why.advertising: No ads in the app (docs/NATIVE.md §2.3: Marquee is a web loader only).
